The selection metric's FLEURS set: FLEURS dev, 26 languages (the 24 EU ones plus ru and uk), 200 clips per language (fewer where dev holds fewer, nl 171), drawn once with seed 0 and frozen. Prompt: format-repeatfirst.yaml. Raw CER per language, never clipped; `all` = share of runaway clips pooled over the 26 languages.

The selection metric's in-domain sets: held-out CV22, MLS and VoxPopuli splits of the five trained languages (en de es fr it), 200 utterances from each = 600 per language, frozen. Prompt: format-repeatfirst.yaml. Raw CER per language; `all` = share of runaway clips pooled over the five.

The campaign's selection metric (projects/ablation-campaign/selection-metric/README.md) computed by that folder's score.py from selection-id and selection-fleurs26-dev200: `score` (unit all) and the group medians of clipped CER (units id, ood-train, ood-related, ood-latin, ood-script), all on the fraction scale. Derived from the CER columns above; a write that changes those must rewrite these.
